Name: TANK_ARMOUR_PARAM
Description: Defines params related to tank armor movement.

Fields.Name: Wheel Tilt Index A: Front
Fields.Description: Index of the front wheel of wheel pair A, used to calculate tilt.

Fields.Name: Wheel Tilt Index A: Rear
Fields.Description: Index of the rear wheel of wheel pair A, used to calculate tilt.

Fields.Name: Wheel Tilt Index B: Front
Fields.Description: Index of the front wheel of wheel pair B, used to calculate tilt.

Fields.Name: Wheel Tilt Index B: Rear
Fields.Description: Index of the rear wheel of wheel pair B, used to calculate tilt.

Fields.Name: Suspension Distance
Fields.Description: Distance between the suspensions. In metres.

Fields.Name: Application Rate %
Fields.Description: The rate at which to apply these parameters.

Fields.Name: Bone Axis
Fields.Description: Bone axis these parameters are applied on. 0: X, 1: Y, 2: Z.
